heard: He was 23 when he took the throne His mother, Hamato, from Litna, was known Three short months in Jerusalem he stayed Evil in the Lord's sight was the way Pharaoh Necho came to take his place Riblah became his prison and his race A hundred talents of silver and gold The heavy weight of the tribute toll He could not reign in Jerusalem's gate Imprisoned in the land of Hammer State His brother Eli Kim
